appraisal_events.evidence: tous interrogeaient sur son compte leur ami le maître d'hôtel... et mesdames leurs épouses, sachant que sa femme attendait un bébé, travaillaient après les repas chacune à une pièce de la layette
appraisal_events.explanation: The exclusive hotel coterie treats Aimé, the returning headwaiter, as a trusted insider — consulting him to vet newcomers and showing personal solicitude toward his wife's pregnancy — a quiet elevation within their circle even as they scrutinize and snub other guests.

status_effects.explanation: Aimé is treated as a familiar, trusted insider ('leur ami') by the socially exclusive hotel set, in contrast to the wary scrutiny they direct at other guests.
